product.title: Cortech Safebin Trash Receptacle
product.body_html:
The Cortech Safebin is the ultimate solution for maintaining cleanliness and security. Its tamper-resistant chute keeps bag liners out of reach, while the integrated lock adds an extra layer of security.

  • Rotationally molded without metal hinges for increased safety
  • Bolts to the floor and/or wall
  • 35-gallon capacity inner container can be used with or without trash liners
  • Tamper-resistant waste chute system prevents access to garbage bag and discarded content
  • Integrated lock with master key
  • Slightly sloped bottom interior for easy cleaning and drainage
  • Top color: Black
  • Body color: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Sand, Slate Blue, Stone Gray (standard Endurance colors)
  • 10 year warranty
  • Manufactured in the USA to ISO Quality Standards

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
